title: Vectors: ACK round-trip cases
description: Create test vectors for ACK round-trips. Acceptance: covers all bitmap patterns, window boundaries, used by all implementations.
close_reason: SATISFIED by test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json: control_messages vector pins exact ACK-on-Error control bytes for windows 0 and 1 (ack_success_w0/w1, ack_req_w0/w1, sender_abort, receiver_abort); all0_window_transition is a deterministic window-transition transcript incl. dropped fcn_31, exact ACK bitmap failure bytes (783fffffffbf) and retransmission; recover_missing_regular_tile provides partial-bitmap ACK round-trip with retransmission; window boundaries covered by all0 transition + capacity vectors; NEGATIVES ack_success_extra_octet (ack_success_trailing_bits) and unassigned_bitmap_bit (unassigned_bitmap_bit_set) reject malformed ACKs; schc_fragment.json adds ooo_retransmit NACK-bitmap round-trip.
